findings.message: The ADTS stream changes 65 times, first at 0x117 from AAC LC, 44100 Hz, channel configuration 1 to AAC LC, 48000 Hz, channel configuration 1.
6 frames are in no stream: the analyzer keeps at most 64 streams, one per run of one fixed header, and the frame at 0x45C0 is the first to start another.
